applicability.reason: Exercise explicit owner enable, durable dispatch, current-source worker read and persistent success readback.
Reject invalid cadence, missing owner opt-in, stale versions, invalid app identity and ambiguous Apple connections.
Bound transient retries, disable on connection rotation, fence pause races and block after three terminal failures.
Bind reads to schedule/app/connection versions and atomically persist metrics with job completion.
Do not copy credential material into schedule status; keep the scheduled operation read-only and app-scoped.
Inspect at most 100 schedules per tick and limit each scheduled read to three transient attempts.
This backend-only slice adds no user interface or input behavior.
The worker reads Apple Analytics externally; all test provider and signed-segment calls are mocked, with no live account claim.

checks.requirement: Owner opt-in survives restart, queues the latest-complete daily download read and records the metrics and successful job state.
Validate explicit owner choice, 24-168 hour cadence, current schedule version, numeric app identity and exactly one valid matching Apple connection.
Stop persistence after pause or connection rotation, cap transient retry attempts at three, and disable after three terminal failures until explicit resume.
Fence stale jobs with schedule/app/connection versions and commit observations together with the leased job completion.
Expose no credential reference or connection hash in schedule status and grant no provider write, campaign, spending or publication operation.
Keep each poll bounded to 100 schedule rows and each scheduled provider read to three transient attempts.
Exercise report reads and segment downloads with deterministic mocks only; make no live Apple account or provider acceptance claim.
